dedupe_keys.name: reliability based determination of the water cement ratio for concrete mix design data and code

description: The concrete-mix researchers publish data and code for a reliability-based choice of added water in reinforced-concrete production. Zenodo provides one ZIP under MIT. The own-page method treats aggregate moisture as a bounded random variable, maps it to effective water-cement ratio and then to compressive strength through an exponential Abrams-law relationship. A Beta moisture distribution yields a characteristic-strength expression and a design operator for a target fifth-percentile strength. This model can explore process-control uncertainty and material use when specifying concrete for infrastructure structures. No related catalogue record explicitly covers the deposited code. Coverage is the one-dimensional formulation and datasets used for calibration, not a full structural reliability assessment of a bridge or building. A limitation is that assumed moisture distributions and empirical strength parameters influence the answer; the page says deterministic models explain only part of observed variability. The public page does not identify the archived programming language. No ZIP was downloaded or design value reproduced.
